name: Disk Doctor
tagline: Finds what is eating your Mac's drive, explains it, and deletes nothing without your OK.
description: It starts with a read-only scan of a full Mac, then reports in plain language what is taking the space and what is safe to let go. You approve each group before anything is removed, so a cleanup never runs ahead of you. Useful before a system upgrade or when the drive is down to its last gigabytes.
author: thecsguy
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
